data.note: ONS figures are for Dudley constituency (2024 boundaries), not the whole Dudley borough. Each figure has its own reference period. Claimant count is not the unemployment rate; employment survey estimates have sampling uncertainty. Census health and housing indicators are shown separately, with their 2021 reference date and aggregation method.
